template.template: Slurm GPU node by Zabbix agent
template.name: Slurm GPU node by Zabbix agent
template.description:
GPU utilisation on a Slurm compute node.
Runs bin/slurm_zabbix.py --mode gpu on the node itself: nvidia-smi reports what each GPU is doing, scontrol/sinfo report which GPUs Slurm allocated, and the two are reported side by side.
Link this to the GPU nodes, not to the host representing the cluster. That host carries "Slurm cluster by Zabbix agent", which reports allocation for the whole cluster but cannot see device utilisation.
Requires: the Zabbix agent, nvidia-smi and the Slurm client commands on the node, plus the slurm.gpu UserParameter from agent/slurm-gpu.conf.

item.name: Slurm GPU: Get GPU data
item.description: What this node's GPUs are doing, from nvidia-smi, together with what Slurm allocated on the node. Every GPU metric depends on this item.

item.name: Slurm GPU: Node name
item.description: Slurm node name the allocation was looked up under. If this is not the name Slurm knows, allocation reads zero: set it with --node in the UserParameter.

item.name: Slurm GPU: GPUs allocated by Slurm
item.description: GPUs Slurm has handed to jobs on this node.

item.name: Slurm GPU: Allocation
item.description: Allocated GPUs as a percentage of the GPUs present. Compare with utilisation: allocation well above utilisation means jobs are holding GPUs they are not using.

item.name: Slurm GPU: GPUs busy
item.description: GPUs actually doing work, that is above {$SLURM.GPU.IDLE.BELOW}% utilisation.

item.name: Slurm GPU: GPUs allocated but idle
item.description:
GPUs Slurm has allocated to a job while the device itself is doing nothing. This is wasted capacity: the GPU is unavailable to everyone else and unused by its owner.
A short spell is normal between job phases; a sustained count is worth chasing.

item.name: Slurm GPU: Utilisation, mean
item.description: Mean utilisation across the GPUs on this node.

item.name: Slurm GPU: Collector errors
item.description: Errors reported while querying nvidia-smi or Slurm.

discovery_rule.name: Slurm GPU: GPU discovery
discovery_rule.description: Discovers the GPUs nvidia-smi reports on this node.

item_prototype.description: Whether Slurm has given this device to a job.

item_prototype.name: GPU [{#GPU}]: Allocated but idle
item_prototype.description: Allocated to a job that is not using it.

trigger_prototype.name: GPU [{#GPU}]: Allocated but idle
trigger_prototype.description: This GPU has been allocated to a job that is not using it.

trigger.name: Slurm GPU: GPUs are allocated but idle
trigger.description:
Jobs are holding GPUs without using them. The capacity is unavailable to everyone else and unused by its owner.
Raise {$SLURM.GPU.IDLE.TIME} on a cluster whose jobs have long quiet phases, such as data loading between epochs.

trigger.name: Slurm GPU: Collector reported errors
trigger.description: nvidia-smi or the Slurm client commands could not be queried. The item 'Collector errors' holds the messages.

trigger.name: Slurm GPU: Temperature is above {$SLURM.GPU.TEMP.MAX}
trigger.description: A GPU is running hot enough to be throttled.
